privacy.metaDescription: How Buisnez collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Buisnez helps people across Pakistan discover local businesses and share honest reviews. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you use Buisnez, why we collect it, who we share it with and the choices you have. By using Buisnez you agree to the practices described here.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this policy, want a copy of your information, or want your account or content removed, write to us at:

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need to run Buisnez. This includes:
items: Account details: your name, email address and password. Your password is stored only as a one-way hash, so we cannot read it. You may also add an optional phone number, short bio and profile photo.
Sign-in with Google or Facebook: if you choose these options we receive basic profile details such as your name and email address from that provider. We do not receive your password.
Content you create: reviews and ratings, photos, favourites, reports, business claims, edit suggestions and any business listing information you submit.
Technical and safety data: the IP address used when you sign up (to detect spam and fake accounts), and standard request information such as browser type and the pages you request.
Location: only when you tap “Use my location” and allow your browser to share it. Your device does not share its location with us otherwise.

sections.heading: How we use your information
items: To create and secure your account, including emailing you to verify your address and reset your password.
To publish your reviews, photos and public profile, and to show you relevant businesses near you.
To moderate content, investigate reports and prevent spam, fraud and abuse.
To understand how Buisnez is used and to find and fix errors, so we can improve the service.
To meet legal obligations and respond to lawful requests.

sections.heading: What is public
paragraphs: Reviews, ratings and photos you post are public. Your public profile shows your name, profile photo, bio, the month you joined and counts of your reviews, photos and helpful votes. Do not include information in a review that you do not want others to see.

Photos you upload are re-processed on our servers, which removes embedded metadata such as GPS coordinates and camera details. Your email address, phone number and sign-up IP address are never shown publicly.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: We use a small number of cookies that are strictly necessary to keep you logged in:
items: access_token: a short-lived login cookie (about 15 minutes).
refresh_token: a longer-lived cookie that keeps you signed in without asking for your password again.

sections.heading: Analytics and error monitoring
paragraphs: When enabled, we use product analytics (PostHog) to see which pages and features are used, and error monitoring (Sentry) to detect and fix problems. These services may receive technical data such as your browser, device type, pages visited and error details. We do not currently use advertising cookies or sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Who we share information with
paragraphs: We share personal information only with service providers that help us run Buisnez, and only as needed for that purpose:
items: Hosting, database and file storage providers that store the information described above.
Email delivery providers that send verification and password-reset emails.
Analytics and error-monitoring providers described above, when enabled.
OpenStreetMap: maps on Buisnez load map tiles from OpenStreetMap servers, so your IP address and the area of the map you view are visible to them.
Google or Facebook, if you choose to sign in with them.

sections.heading: Moderation and legal disclosures
paragraphs: Our moderators and administrators can see your account and content as needed to review reports and enforce our rules. Business owners can see public reviews of their listing, not your private details. We may disclose information if required by law, to protect people’s safety, or to protect Buisnez and its users from fraud or abuse.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep your information for as long as your account is active and as needed to provide Buisnez, resolve disputes, prevent abuse and meet legal requirements. Removed content and closed accounts may remain in backups for a limited period before they are permanently deleted.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We protect your information with measures such as hashing passwords, using HTTP-only login cookies, limiting login attempts and restricting internal access. No online service is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
items: View and update your name, bio and profile photo from your account page at any time.
Withdraw location access at any time in your browser settings.
Ask us for a copy of your personal information, to correct it, or to delete your account and content by contacting us below.
Manage or block cookies in your browser; note that blocking the login cookies will prevent you from staying signed in.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Buisnez is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will remove it.

sections.heading: Where your information is processed
paragraphs: Buisnez is made in Pakistan, but our service providers may process information on servers in other countries. By using Buisnez you understand that your information may be transferred to and processed in those locations.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. When we make important changes we will update the date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, let you know in another way.
